title: The mourning household; Paris like a horse
intro: Andromache's household mourns Hector while he is still alive. Paris returns in an exuberant horse simile, sharply changing the emotional register.

notes.text: κόρυς acc sg, helmet; ἵππουρις acc sg fem, horse-tailed / with a horsehair crest, separated from its noun by the verse end.
οἶκον δέ = οἶκόνδε, homeward; βαίνω 3sg plup, had gone / was on her way.
ἐντροπαλίζομαι pres mid ptc, repeatedly turning around. She keeps looking back as she leaves.
θαλερός, abundant / welling; δάκρυ singular collective, tears. κατά goes with χέουσα, pouring down.
κιχάνομαι 3sg aor mid, came upon / found; one of the epic verbs of reaching or overtaking.
γόος, lament; ἐνόρνυμι 3sg aor, stirred up, with dat τῇσιν … πάσῃσιν, in all the women.
ζωός, alive, acc agreeing with Hector; γοάω 3pl unaugmented impf contracted, lamented. Distinguish the verb γόον here from the noun at 499.
φημί 3pl impf mid, thought / expected; ἱκνέομαι fut mid inf, would come. Subject μιν = Hector.
ὑπότροπος, returning; προφεύγω aor ptc acc masc, having escaped beforehand / safely escaped. Both describe Hector.
δηθύνω 3sg impf, lingered; related to δηθά, for a long time.
καταδύω 3sg root aor, put on / entered into; τεύχεα neut pl, armor. ποικίλα χαλκῷ: richly worked with bronze.
σεύω 3sg aor mid, rushed; κραιπνός dat pl, swift, describing his feet.
πείθω perf ptc with active sense, trusting / confident, with dat ποσίν. The perfect stem has a settled present meaning.
στατός, stalled / kept in a stall; ἀκοστάω aor ptc, fed on barley / fed full. Paris resembles a well-fed horse released from confinement.
φάτνη dat sg, manger / feeding trough; ἐπί + dat, at.
ἀπορρήγνυμι aor ptc, having broken away / burst; object δεσμόν, tether.
θέω 3sg pres subj, runs, in a generic simile after ὅτε; κροαίνω pres ptc, stamping / beating the ground with its hooves.
Genitives: over the plain; in / at the river, with λούεσθαι. Epic gen often carries a local relation without a preposition.
ἔθω perf ptc, accustomed; ἐϋρρεής gen sg, fair-flowing, agreeing with ποταμοῖο.
κυδιάω pres ptc, exulting / glorying, epic expanded form; κάρη, head, neut acc sg.
ἀγλαΐη, splendor / beauty, with old -φι ending functioning as dat after πεποιθώς.
ῥίμφα, swiftly / lightly; γόνυ neut pl γοῦνα, knees. Neut pl subject with singular φέρει; ἑ acc, him / it.
ἦθος neut pl, accustomed haunts; νομός, pasture. μετά + acc: toward the horses' familiar pasture grounds.
κατά + gen, down from the height of Pergamus, Troy's citadel.
ἠλέκτωρ, the beaming sun; βαίνω 3sg plup, was striding along. παμφαίνων: shining all over.
καγχάλαω pres ptc, exulting; τέτμον 3sg reduplicated aor, met / came upon.
στρέφω fut mid inf after ἔμελλε, was about to turn away; ὀαρίζω 3sg impf, conversed intimately, with dat γυναικί.
ἠθεῖος voc, affectionate address to a respected brother; σεύω perf mid/pass ptc acc masc, hastening / eager.
κατερύκω, hold back / delay; ἐναίσιμος neut adverbial, in due measure, here at the proper time.
εἰμί 3sg pres opt in an indefinite relative clause: any man who was fair-minded. Hector's main clause continues next page.
